title: In vivo CRISPR screen for germinal center B cells in mice using ecotropic retrovirus
author: Hong, Nussenzweig
materials: NEBuilder HiFi DNA Assembly Master Mix
Phusion Green HSII HF DNA Polymerase

steps.title: Seed Plat‑E cells
steps.instruction: On day −1, seed 0.3 × 10⁶ Plat‑E cells per well in a 6‑well plate with 3 mL antibiotic‑free culture medium.

steps.title: Determine virus titer and cell numbers
steps.instruction: Perform a GeneJuice transfection optimization to achieve a target MOI of 0.25 (≈20 % infected, ≤3 % double‑infected). For 500–1 000× library coverage, calculate required transduced cells (e.g., 1 000‑sgRNA library needs 10⁶ transduced cells; with 20 % efficiency use 5 × 10⁶ cells; multiply by 4 for engraftment → ≥2 × 10⁷ cells).

steps.title: Transfect Plat‑E cells
steps.instruction: On day 0, transfect each well using GeneJuice: mix 2 µg pooled sgRNA library with 3 µL GeneJuice in 100 µL Opti‑MEM, dispense slowly keeping the tip ≥2 mm below the liquid surface and changing tip position every second, then add to the cells following the manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: Collect and store viral supernatant
steps.instruction: On day 2, collect the culture supernatant, optionally filter through a 0.45 µm polyethersulfone filter, and freeze at −80 °C (freeze‑thaw cycles up to three do not significantly reduce transduction efficiency; polybrene is not required).

steps.title: Euthanize mice and harvest spleens
steps.instruction: At day 10 post NP‑OVA immunization, euthanize mice according to institutional guidelines, remove spleens, mince, and pass through a 70 µm cell strainer to obtain a single‑cell suspension (no enzymes needed).

steps.title: Count and prepare splenocytes
steps.instruction: Count cells (typical 0.3–1 × 10⁸ cells per spleen), spin at 300 × g, 4 °C for 5 min, and resuspend 1 × 10⁸ cells per mL FACS buffer.

steps.title: Label cells with surface antibodies
steps.instruction: Add 1 µg anti‑IgD mAb and 1 µg anti‑CD38 mAb per mL cell suspension, incubate 15 min at 4 °C while rotating; wash with 10 mL FACS buffer, spin as before, and resuspend 1 × 10⁸ cells in 700 µL FACS buffer.

steps.title: Enrich GC B cells with magnetic beads
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL each of CD43, Ter‑119, and Streptavidin microbeads to the 700 µL suspension, incubate 15 min at 4 °C rotating; wash with 10 mL FACS buffer, spin, then isolate GC B cells using Miltenyi microbeads per the manufacturer’s instructions; spin at 300 × g, 4 °C for 10 min.

steps.title: Block Fc receptors and stain
steps.instruction: Resuspend cells at 1 × 10⁸ per 200 µL FACS buffer containing Fc‑blocking antibody (anti‑CD16/CD32) at 1 µg/mL, incubate 15 min at 4 °C. Prepare staining mix with Zombie NIR live/dead dye (1:250), anti‑B220, anti‑CD38, anti‑CD95 each 2 µg/mL; add 200 µL mix to the cells, incubate 15 min at 4 °C, then wash with 10 mL FACS buffer.

steps.title: Sort transduced GC B cells
steps.instruction: Using a BD FACS Aria II with a 70 µm nozzle, sort live/dead‑, B220+, CD38‑, CD95+, mTagBFP2+ cells at 10 000 events/sec into 1.5 mL tubes containing 300 µL PBS; collect ≥5 × 10⁵ cells per replicate (3–4 replicates pooled from 20 mice), spin at 300 × g, 4 °C for 5 min, and store pellets at −80 °C.

steps.title: Thaw pellets and extract gDNA
steps.instruction: Thaw frozen cell pellets at 20–25 °C, extract genomic DNA with a QIAamp DNA Blood Mini Kit: add 4 µL RNase A (100 mg/mL) to 200 µL PBS containing 10⁶ cells, load up to 10⁶ cells per column, elute twice with 50 µL nuclease‑free water (incubate 20–25 °C 5 min each) and combine eluates.

steps.title: Ethanol precipitate gDNA (optional)
steps.instruction: To each eluate add 2 µL Pellet Paint, then 0.1 volume 3 M sodium acetate, vortex; add 2 volumes ethanol, vortex, incubate 20–25 °C 2 min; spin 16 000 × g, 4 °C 5 min, discard supernatant; wash sequentially with 70 % ethanol then 100 % ethanol, vortex each time, spin as before; air‑dry pellet and dissolve in 12 µL nuclease‑free water (up to 10⁶ cells). Measure DNA concentration (Nanodrop or Qubit); aim for 100–500 ng per 10⁵ cells.

steps.title: Prepare PCR master mix
steps.instruction: For each 20 µL reaction combine: 4 µL 5× Phusion Green HF buffer (1× final), 4 µL 10 mM dNTP (200 µM final), 2 µL 5 µM forward primer (500 nM), 2 µL 5 µM reverse primer (500 nM), 0.2 µL DMSO (0.6 % final), 7.2 µL gDNA (≥500 ng for a 1 000‑sgRNA library), and 0.2 µL Phusion Hot Start II (0.02 U/µL).

steps.title: Run PCR with cycling conditions
steps.instruction: Thermal profile: 98 °C 1 min initial denaturation; 33 cycles of 98 °C 10 s denaturation, 62.5 °C 30 s annealing, 72 °C 15 s extension; final extension 72 °C 5 min; hold at 4 °C indefinitely.

steps.title: Gel‑purify PCR product
steps.instruction: Run PCR products on a 2 % agarose gel with a DNA ladder, excise the 500 bp band, purify using a gel‑extraction kit per the manufacturer, and measure concentration (expected 300–1 000 ng) with Nanodrop or Qubit.

steps.title: Sequence libraries on Illumina
steps.instruction: Submit the purified PCR libraries for Illumina sequencing; for a 1 000‑sgRNA library, use the 33‑cycle PCR products and aim for ~400 million total reads.

steps.title: Analyze sequencing data
steps.instruction: Map reads to the reference sgRNA library using Geneious or an equivalent program, export a counts table, and run MAGeCK to calculate gene enrichment and depletion; optionally normalize with the --control-sgrna option.
